claims.scope: endRewards pair address computation in Launchpad.sol versus pair creation in GTELaunchpadV2PairFactory.sol

preconditions.text: A pair for a launched token is created by createPair in GTELaunchpadV2PairFactory.sol using a salt that includes _launchpadLp and _launchpadFeeDistributor.; The pairFor function computes the pair address from token0, token1, and uniV2InitCodeHash.
preconditions.derivation: Program conjunction of selected report preconditions.

safety.text: endRewards should successfully terminate the rewards accrual process for a launched token rather than reverting.
safety.derivation: Program synthesis from the selected intent and logical pattern.

effects.text: preventing the protocol from terminating the rewards accrual process for a launched token
effects.derivation: Program-generated direct negation witness for the selected safety pattern.

effect_coverage.reason: Program-generated exact coverage for selected direct impact.

assumptions: endRewards is invoked for a launched token whose pair was created by createPair (end_rewards_called, end_rewards_calls_distributor).
The report does not state any caller authorization for endRewards; the plan does not encode one.

limitations: The selected impact is formalized as a progress/liveness obligation: under the stated pair-creation and pairFor conditions, endRewards must complete and terminate rewards accrual.
The address-mismatch root cause and the revert are not encoded as P; they are the reported violation mechanism, not preconditions.
Other listed impacts (end_rewards_reverts, end_rewards_dos, rewards_management_disrupted) are not formalized by this plan.
